question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_dev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT 
  s.avg_loss_rate,
  s.std_dev_loss_rate,
  s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate AS lower_bound,
  s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate AS upper_bound,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_below,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate AND v."loss_rate_%" <= s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_within,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_above
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
GROUP BY s.avg_loss_rate, s.std_dev_loss_rate
